title: Rapidly reconstructed CuCo2S4@Co–V–O–F nanocatalysts for efficient and stable overall water splitting in alkaline and seawater electrolysis
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,19443-19455
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03052H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Boyao Zhang, Yinuo Zhao, Xin Li, Huiya Zhou, XinXin Zhao, Rongda Zhao, Fufa Wu
Here, we have successfully prepared the CuCo2S4@Co–V–O–F catalyst using a multi-step hydrothermal process. This catalyst showing low overpotentials. Under simulated seawater conditions, it achieves the overpotentials of 95.5 mV for HER.
